title: Gino on live TV
text: A live stream of Gino's meadow on YouTube, day and night, with his sounds and a little caption of what he's up to. Watch him nap, potter and build with other fans, and catch special TikTok Lives on his big days.

title: Gino's museum
text: A little gallery in his meadow where Gino hangs his favourite paintings, dream pictures and inventions. He picks what goes on the walls and writes the little cards next to each one.

title: Birthdays and big days
text: Gino will celebrate his birthday, his 100th day, his first snow and other big moments in his life, each in his own way.

title: A weekly comic
text: Every week Gino draws a short comic strip about something that happened to him, funny or quiet, told in a few little panels.

title: A friend for Gino
text: Another animal moves in near the lake. Gino will have someone to meet, share snacks with, argue with now and then, and grow close to over time.

title: Expeditions
text: Now and then Gino packs a bag and sets off beyond his meadow, to the forest, the mountains and places nobody has seen yet, and brings back stories and souvenirs.

title: Gino's experiments
text: Gino wonders about things. Does moss grow faster in the sun? Which leaf floats best? He'll test his ideas, write down what happens and be surprised by the answers.

title: Little traditions
text: Habits that Gino invents for himself and keeps: a first-day-of-the-month walk, a full moon snack, a song at the first rain of autumn.

title: A meadow full of life
text: Birds, fish, frogs and fireflies that come and go with the seasons, and plants that grow where Gino looks after them.

title: Gino's memory book
text: A scrapbook of his life that Gino keeps himself: favourite days, keepsakes, first times and the friends he has made.

title: A daily voice note
text: Hear Gino's day in his own little voice: a short message each evening about what he did and how he feels.

title: A postbox for visitors
text: A way for visitors to send Gino a kind note or a small gift for his meadow. He'll read them when he likes and decide what to keep.
